ALGORITHM BinarySearch(array, target)
    SET low = 0
    SET high = length(array) - 1

    WHILE low <= high DO
        SET mid = floor((low + high) / 2)

        IF array[mid] == target THEN
            RETURN mid
        ELSE IF array[mid] < target THEN
            SET low = mid + 1
        ELSE
            SET high = mid - 1
        END IF
    END WHILE

    RETURN -1
END ALGORITHM
